seo.title: About | Commitpress starter
seo.description: A small collection of pages and sections, ready to make your own.

page_header.heading: A starting point, with space to grow.
page_header.lead: This example shows how a few reusable sections can become a complete page. Everything here is ready to be replaced with your own content.

items.question: Can I change the look?
items.answer: Yes. Colors, typography, and the page width are defined together in the theme. Adjust them once to give the whole site your own visual identity.

items.question: Where does the content live?
items.answer: The example pages and site settings live in the repository, under __commitpress__/content. You can edit them directly or connect the repository to Commitpress.

items.question: Can I add my own sections?
items.answer: Yes. Add a section to the page schema and its component to the block renderer. Start small and add what your site needs.

cta.heading: Start with something simple.
cta.body: You don't need a big site to make a good first impression. A clear message and a few thoughtful details go a long way.
